argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $b='http://127.0.0.1:17448'; $assign=Invoke-RestMethod ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 5; $a=@($assign.assignments); $q=@($a | Where-Object {$_.state -eq 'queued'}); $risk=@($a | Where-Object {$_.state -in @('unknown','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence')}); Write-Output ('QUEUED_COUNT='+$q.Count); Write-Output ('UNCERTAIN_OR_ACTIVE_COUNT='+$risk.Count); foreach($x in $q){Write-Output ('QUEUED_ID_DIGEST='+([Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes([string]$x.id))).Substring(0,16)));Write-Output ('QUEUED_ATTEMPTED='+$x.dispatchSubmitAttempted);Write-Output ('QUEUED_DISPATCHCOUNT='+$x.dispatchCount);Write-Output ('QUEUED_HAS_CI='+([bool]$x.ciRunId));Write-Output ('QUEUED_AGENT_BOUND='+([bool]$x.targetChatId))}; Write-Output ('LIVE_BRIDGE_PROCESS_COUNT='+(@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match 'WebAIBridge.{0,150}server\.js'}).Count))

note: Read-only hashed queued original id and provenance risk counts, no raw chat ids/messages and no dispatch
